accepted.quote: While we agree that studying the electric supply chain is an important end goal, we cannot support an irresponsible bill that unfairly burdens Department of Energy staff with additional directives without assessing their existing capacities.
accepted.bill: H.R. 3638, the Electric Supply Chain Act
accepted.rationale: The legislator states he cannot support the bill imposing new supply-chain directives on DOE staff without assessing capacity.
